verse.verse_3: We revealed it on a Blessed Night, for We were intent on warning;
verse.verse_4: (We revealed it on the Night) wherein every matter is wisely determined
verse.verse_5: by Our command. Verily, We were set to send a Messenger
verse.verse_6: as a Mercy from your Lord. Surely He is All-Hearing, All-Seeing,
verse.verse_7: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them: if you would only have sure faith.
verse.verse_8: There is no god but He: He gives life and causes death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.
verse.verse_9: (But the fact is, they lack certainty) and frolic about in doubt.
verse.verse_10: So watch for the Day when the sky will come down with a pall of smoke,
verse.verse_11: enveloping people. That will be a grievous scourge.
verse.verse_12: (People will then say): “Our Lord, remove this scourge from us; we shall believe.”
verse.verse_13: But how will they take heed? Such are they that a Messenger came to them clearly expounding the Truth,
verse.verse_14: yet they turned away from him and said: “This is a well-tutored madman.”
verse.verse_15: Yet We will hold the scourge back for a while, (but no sooner than We will do so) you will revert to your old ways.
verse.verse_16: The Day when We shall seize them with a mighty seizing, that will be the Day on which We shall inflict upon you full retribution.
verse.verse_17: Indeed before that We subjected the Pharaonites to the same test. A noble Messenger came to them
verse.verse_18: (and said): “Deliver to me Allah's servants. I am a trustworthy Messenger to you,
verse.verse_19: and do not exalt yourselves in defiance of Allah. I have come to you with a clear authority (as a Messenger).
verse.verse_20: I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest you should attack me with stones.
verse.verse_21: But if you do not believe what I say, leave me alone (and desist from laying hands on me).”
verse.verse_22: Then he called upon his Lord: “These are a criminal people.”
verse.verse_23: (He was told): “Set out with My servants by night for you will certainly be pursued.
verse.verse_24: And leave the sea behind you as calm as ever. Surely they are an army that is doomed to be drowned.”
verse.verse_25: How many gardens did they leave behind, and how many fountains
verse.verse_26: and sown fields and splendid mansions,
verse.verse_27: and the life of ease in which they took delight!
verse.verse_28: Thus it was; and We made another people inherit all that.
verse.verse_29: Then neither the sky shed tears over them nor the earth. They were granted no respite.
verse.verse_30: Thus did We deliver the Children of Israel from the humiliating chastisement,
verse.verse_31: from Pharaoh who was most prominent among the prodigals.
verse.verse_32: We knowingly exalted them (i.e., the Children of Israel) above other peoples of the world
verse.verse_33: and bestowed upon them the Signs wherein lay an evident test for them.
verse.verse_35: “This is our first and only death, and we shall never be raised again.
verse.verse_36: Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.”
verse.verse_37: Are these better or the people of Tubba and those who went before them? We destroyed them for they were a criminal people.
verse.verse_38: It was not in idle sport that We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.
verse.verse_39: We did not create them except in Truth. But most of them do not know.
verse.verse_40: The Day of Final Decision is the appointed time for all;
verse.verse_41: the Day when a friend shall be of no avail to his friend nor shall they be helped,
verse.verse_42: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate.
verse.verse_44: shall be the food of the sinful.
verse.verse_45: Like dregs of oil, it will boil in their bellies
verse.verse_47: “Seize him and drag him to the middle of the Blazing Fire,
verse.verse_48: then pour boiling water over his head as chastisement.
verse.verse_49: Taste this, you are a person mighty and noble!
verse.verse_50: This is what you used to doubt.”
verse.verse_51: Verily the God-fearing shall be in a secure place
verse.verse_53: Attired in silk and brocade, they shall be arrayed face to face.
verse.verse_54: Thus shall it be: and We shall espouse them to fair, wide-eyed maidens.
verse.verse_55: While resting in security, they shall call for all kinds of fruit.
verse.verse_56: They shall not taste death except the death in this world. And Allah will save them from the chastisement of Hell
verse.verse_57: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great triumph.
verse.verse_58: (O Prophet), We have made this Book easy in your tongue so that they may take heed.
verse.verse_59: Wait, then; they too are waiting.
